test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are standing together, each having a different height. A is taller than D, but shorter than F. C is shorter than E and taller than B, who is taller than F. Only one person is taller than E, and only two persons are shorter than D. If no other person is part of the group, what is the total number of people in the group?
solution:
According to the given information:

1). Only One person is taller than E

__ > E

2). C is shorter than E and taller than B, who is taller than F.

__ > E > C > B > F

3). A is taller than D, but shorter than F

__ > E > C > B > F > A > D

4). Only two persons shorter than D

__ > E > C > B > F > A > D > __ > __

And, no other person is part of the group,

So, there are 'Nine' people in the group.

Hence, **"Nine"** is the correct answer.
